WITH active AS (
  SELECT id FROM pending_orders
  WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint AND status IN ('cart', 'checkout')
  ORDER BY (status = 'cart') DESC, id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
reopened AS (
  UPDATE pending_orders SET status = 'cart', updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM active)
  RETURNING id
),
created AS (
  INSERT INTO pending_orders (chat_id, status)
  SELECT $1::bigint, 'cart' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active)
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
cart AS (
  SELECT id FROM reopened UNION ALL SELECT id FROM created
),
product AS (
  SELECT product_id, name, price, currency FROM product_cache WHERE product_id = $2::int
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO pending_order_items (order_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, price, subtotal, currency)
  SELECT cart.id, product.product_id, product.name, 1,
         COALESCE(product.price, 0), COALESCE(product.price, 0), product.currency
  FROM cart CROSS JOIN product
  ON CONFLICT (order_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET
    quantity = pending_order_items.quantity + 1,
    subtotal = (pending_order_items.quantity + 1) * EXCLUDED.price,
    price = EXCLUDED.price
  RETURNING product_name, quantity, price, subtotal, currency
)
SELECT * FROM ins

WITH active AS (
  SELECT id FROM pending_orders
  WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint AND status IN ('cart', 'checkout')
  ORDER BY (status = 'cart') DESC, id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
items AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS item_count FROM pending_order_items
  WHERE order_id = (SELECT id FROM active)
),
u AS (
  UPDATE pending_orders SET status = 'checkout', updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM active) AND (SELECT item_count FROM items) > 0
  RETURNING id, delivery_address
),
need AS (
  SELECT ((SELECT item_count FROM items) > 0
          AND ($2::boolean OR COALESCE(BTRIM((SELECT delivery_address FROM u)), '') = '')) AS need_address
),
arm AS (
  INSERT INTO pending_order (telegram_id, status, awaiting, updated_at)
  SELECT $1::bigint, 'cart', 'address', NOW() WHERE (SELECT need_address FROM need)
  ON CONFLICT (telegram_id) DO UPDATE SET awaiting = 'address', updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT item_count FROM items) AS item_count,
       (SELECT delivery_address FROM u) AS delivery_address,
       (SELECT need_address FROM need) AS need_address

WITH active AS (
  SELECT id FROM pending_orders
  WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint AND status IN ('cart', 'checkout')
  ORDER BY (status = 'cart') DESC, id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
u AS (
  UPDATE pending_orders SET delivery_address = $2::text, status = 'checkout', updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM active)
  RETURNING id, delivery_address
)
SELECT i.product_id, i.product_name, i.quantity, i.price, i.currency,
       i.quantity * i.price AS subtotal,
       (SELECT delivery_address FROM u) AS delivery_address
FROM pending_order_items i
WHERE i.order_id = (SELECT id FROM u)
ORDER BY i.id

WITH target AS (
  SELECT id FROM pending_orders
  WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint AND status = 'checkout'
    AND COALESCE(BTRIM(delivery_address), '') <> ''
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pending_order_items WHERE order_id = pending_orders.id)
  ORDER BY id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
claim AS (
  UPDATE pending_orders po SET status = 'submitting', updated_at = NOW()
  FROM target t WHERE po.id = t.id
  RETURNING po.id, po.chat_id, po.delivery_address
)
SELECT c.id AS order_id, c.chat_id, c.delivery_address,
       i.product_id, i.product_name, i.quantity, i.price, i.currency
FROM claim c
JOIN pending_order_items i ON i.order_id = c.id
ORDER BY i.id

WITH active_order AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM pending_orders
    WHERE chat_id = $4::bigint
      AND status = 'submitting'
    ORDER BY id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
save_quote AS (
    INSERT INTO pending_order (
        telegram_id, quotation_id, quotation_name, status, awaiting, updated_at
    )
    VALUES ($1::bigint, $2::int, $3::text, 'submitted', NULL, NOW())
    ON CONFLICT (telegram_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        quotation_id = EXCLUDED.quotation_id,
        quotation_name = EXCLUDED.quotation_name,
        status = 'submitted',
        awaiting = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING telegram_id
),
finish_order AS (
    UPDATE pending_orders
    SET status = 'submitted',
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM active_order)
    RETURNING id
),
clear_items AS (
    DELETE FROM pending_order_items
    WHERE order_id = (SELECT id FROM active_order)
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT telegram_id FROM save_quote) AS telegram_id,
    (SELECT id FROM finish_order) AS order_id,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clear_items)::int AS cleared_items;

UPDATE pending_orders
SET status = 'checkout',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint
  AND status = 'submitting'
RETURNING id, chat_id, status;

## AI ERP Assistant - Shopping Cart

**Before activating**
1. Run `schema.sql` in PostgreSQL.
2. Select your Postgres credential in every Postgres node (or replace REPLACE_POSTGRES_CRED_ID in the JSON).
3. Deactivate the old Telegram workflow (one bot = one webhook).
4. Odoo needs: POST /quotations (with `lines`), GET /quotations/{id}/ POST /quotations/{id}/confirm and /cancel.

**Settings** : `ENFORCE_STOCK` is at the top of the Format Products code node.

WITH old AS (
  SELECT awaiting, status
  FROM pending_order
  WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint
),
clr AS (
  UPDATE pending_order
  SET awaiting = NULL, updated_at = now()
  WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint
    AND awaiting IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT
  $1::bigint AS telegram_id,
  (SELECT awaiting FROM old) AS awaiting,
  (SELECT status FROM old) AS cart_status;

WITH active AS (
  SELECT id FROM pending_orders
  WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint AND status IN ('cart', 'checkout')
  ORDER BY (status = 'cart') DESC, id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT i.product_id, i.product_name, i.quantity, i.price, i.currency,
       i.quantity * i.price AS subtotal, o.delivery_address
FROM pending_orders o
JOIN pending_order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.id = (SELECT id FROM active)
ORDER BY i.id
